title: Cyber-Physical RSI for AI-RAN: A Case Study
title_zh: 面向 AI-RAN 的信息物理递归自我改进（RSI）：一项案例研究
abstract_en: Learned models for radio access networks (RANs) are often developed using simulation, yet their predictions can shift when exposed to physical propagation conditions, protocol behavior, and equipment implementations. This paper presents a cyber-physical recursive self-improvement (RSI) framework for AI-RAN that connects a task-oriented student model, an experiment-planning coach agent, a calibratable virtual environment, and a physical host agent. Physical measurements are organized as evidence for both model adaptation and subsequent experiment planning. We examine an implementation of the physical-feedback pathway using ping-pong handover as a case study. The system completes 12 physical executions organized into six baseline--candidate pairs, updates the student from measured outcomes, and evaluates the revised model on reserved physical configurations. In the observed short-window tests, increasing the time-to-trigger from 320 to 1280\,ms changes the ping-pong count from three to zero. The updated student achieves a grouped-validation mean absolute error (MAE) of 2.673 round trips/min, while a common three-configuration physical evaluation yields MAEs of 1.240 and 1.601 round trips/min for the pre-feedback and post-feedback models, respectively. These results characterize both the operational feedback loop and the parameter-dependent generalization behavior revealed by new physical experiments.
abstract_zh: 无线接入网（RAN）的学习模型通常在仿真环境中开发，但实际无线传播条件、协议行为和设备实现都可能使模型预测产生偏差。本文提出面向 AI-RAN 的信息物理递归自我改进（RSI）框架，将面向任务的学生模型、负责实验规划的教练智能体、可校准的虚拟环境和物理主机智能体连接起来，以实测数据同时支持模型更新和后续实验规划。作者以乒乓切换（ping-pong handover）为例验证物理反馈流程：完成 12 次物理实验，组成 6 组基线与候选配置对；根据实测结果更新学生模型，再用留出的物理配置进行评估。在观测到的短时测试中，触发时延（time-to-trigger）从 320 ms 增至 1280 ms，乒乓切换次数由 3 次降至 0 次。更新后模型的分组验证平均绝对误差（MAE）为 2.673 次往返/分钟；在相同的 3 个物理配置上，反馈前后的 MAE 分别为 1.240 和 1.601 次往返/分钟。结果表明，该物理反馈闭环能够运行，但模型更新并未降低这组留出配置上的误差，泛化表现随参数配置而异。
key_points_zh: RSI 框架将物理测量同时用于更新学生模型和规划下一轮实验。
乒乓切换案例完成 12 次物理实验，组成 6 组基线与候选配置对，并在留出的物理配置上评估更新后的模型。
在观测到的短时测试中，触发时延从 320 ms 增至 1280 ms，乒乓切换次数由 3 次降至 0 次。
更新后模型的分组验证 MAE 为 2.673 次往返/分钟；在相同的 3 个留出物理配置上，MAE 则由反馈前的 1.240 升至反馈后的 1.601 次往返/分钟。

selection, and a common reserved physical assessment.
